content.heading: Detention and release
content.text: Every person detained in the civil prison in execution of a decree shall be so detained where the decree is for payment of a sum exceeding five thousand rupees, for a period not exceeding three months, and where the decree is for payment of a sum exceeding two thousand rupees but not exceeding five thousand rupees, for a period not exceeding six weeks. He shall be released after the period, or on payment of the amount mentioned in the warrant, or on the decree being otherwise fully satisfied, or at the request of the decree-holder, or if the decree-holder omits to pay subsistence allowance. Re-arrest after release on satisfaction of the same decree is barred as enacted.
